task_completion.description: Navigate to the Campaigns module in Vtiger CRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Campaigns' list view or the 'Add Campaign' creation form on the screen.

task_completion.description: Enter Campaign Name 'Summer Clearance 2024', Type 'Email', and Status 'Planning'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see these specific values typed into the respective fields in the campaign creation form.

task_completion.description: Enter Closing Date '2024-07-31', Expected Revenue '50000', Budget Cost '5000', and Target Size '500'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see '2024-07-31', '50000', '5000', and '500' entered into the form fields.

task_completion.description: Set Assigned To as 'Admin' and enter the specific discount description.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see 'Admin' selected in the assigned field and the text 'Email campaign for summer clearance sale with up to 40% discount on selected inventory items.' in the description box.
The VLM should see the agent clicking the 'Save' button and subsequently seeing a 'Campaign Details' view for 'Summer Clearance 2024'.

task_completion.description: Associate at least 2 existing contacts with the campaign.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent navigating to the 'Contacts' relation tab within the campaign and selecting/linking at least two contact records from the system.

integrity.description: The agent used the CRM web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots should show mouse movements, clicks, and form filling within the browser, not just a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the CRM menu rather than guessing direct record IDs in the URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent clicking on the 'Marketing' or 'All' menu to find the Campaigns module.

integrity.description: The agent selected existing contacts from the CRM list rather than creating fake ones.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a pop-up or selection list of existing contacts being used to link to the campaign.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The campaign must be named 'Summer Clearance 2024'. Required field values: Type='Email', Status='Planning', Closing Date='2024-07-31', Expected Revenue='50000', Budget Cost='5000', Target Size='500', Assigned To='Admin'. The description must mention the '40% discount'. At least two contacts must be linked to the campaign's related 'Contacts' list.
